# Contributing

## Style
- Indent with 4 spaces; lines up to 100 characters.
- Use snake_case for functions and variables, PascalCase for classes.
- Docstrings in Google style; type hints on every public function.
- Imports sorted with isort, formatted with black.
- Commit messages in the imperative mood, under 72 characters for the subject.
- Prefer f-strings over format() and %.
